ask: can u run a snake draft for us, 8 people, random order, and show everyones final 3 movies
sentence: Runs a snake-order draft where everyone in the chat takes turns picking movies from a shared pool, with the order drawn at random and each person's picks shown at the end.
use_when: A group wants to split up a list of movies by taking turns picking
Someone asks for a random draft order with snake turns (1 to n, then n to 1)
The group wants to see everyone's final picks side by side after a draft
Picking movies for a movie night in a fair, turn-based way
dont_use_when: The group wants a simple vote or poll on one choice
Items must be assigned randomly with no choosing, like a raffle or name draw
The draft is for a non-movie list that needs a different pool or pick count set up from scratch
Only one person is asking and there is no group to take turns
